unknown_variants.variant: unknown asset type or enum value
unknown_variants.handling: preserve raw value and surface a validation warning; never guess a canonical type
fail closed before mutation and request an explicit migration

unknown_variants.variant: missing optional column in legacy row
unknown_variants.handling: use the declared backward-compatible default and record a warning

corrupt_samples.safe_action: quarantine the manifest, preserve the original bytes, and show repair preview

corrupt_samples.sample: SQLite integrity failure or unreadable database
corrupt_samples.safe_action: do not overwrite; require backup selection and recovery diagnostics
retain metadata, report missing-file state, and avoid silent deletion

migration_classes.verification: open a disposable copy, run guarded migration, compare schema and row counts
compare stable IDs, links, and deterministic counts before/after
round-trip representative unknown values without guessing or data loss
fail closed, preserve source, and emit a recovery record

limitations: Inventory is source/schema metadata, not a scan of user project databases.
Corrupt samples are contract classes, not injected production damage.
Migration dry-run and backup/restore are separate canonical steps 112.27 and 112.28.
